validation.alpha: Source-generated alpha is copied unchanged; all pixels and RGB are preserved. Alpha range 0–255 in both outputs. Tiny generation alpha noise of at most 8 lies outside NPC silhouettes and at most 1 in the item midpoint gutter; no matte replacement or pixel cleanup applied.
validation.coordinates: x/y/w/h and anchors are absolute source-image coordinates. Visible bounds are exclusive rectangles measured at alpha > 32. Foot anchors use the middle of the lowest 12 visible rows. Fumi bodyHeight excludes her staff top; other heights measure ears to soles.
